headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 19, 2026**
article:
The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing 7-1 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Jared Jones leading the way on the mound. Jones pitched 5.0 innings, striking out 9 batters while allowing just 1 earned run. In other news, the Chicago Cubs secured a 6-2 victory over the Minnesota Twins, with Matthew Boyd earning the win.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Justin Sterner, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right knee chondromalacia. The Athletics right-handed pitcher was injured on July 18, 2026. Other players on the injured list include Lourdes Gurriel Jr. (right adductor strain), Jeff Criswell (right shoulder strain), Sal Frelick (right shoulder strain), Oneil Cruz (left hand fourth and fifth metacarpal non-displaced fractures), Chris Bassitt (low back discomfort), and JoJo Romero (right shoulder strain).

The Chicago Cubs have made a significant trade, acquiring right-handed pitcher Aaron Civale from the Athletics in exchange for right-handed pitcher Aiden Moffett. The Athletics also traded right-handed pitcher Rudy Martin Jr. to the Baltimore Orioles for cash. Additionally, the St. Louis Cardinals acquired right-handed pitcher Trey Pooser from the Tampa Bay Rays, and the Pittsburgh Pirates acquired center fielder Robert Hassell III from the Washington Nationals for cash.

top_news.title: **Pirates Cruise Past Guardians 7-1**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing 7-1 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Jared Jones leading the way on the mound. Jones pitched 5.0 innings, striking out 9 batters while allowing just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Pirates Fall to Guardians in 3-5 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a 3-5 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, handing the Pirates their latest loss. Travis Bazzana led the Pirates' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance, including a key 8th-inning homer that scored Steven Kwan.

top_news.title: **Cubs Cruise Past Twins 6-2**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs secured a 6-2 victory over the Minnesota Twins, with Matthew Boyd earning the win. Kody Clemens led the Twins' offense with two home runs and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Phillies Shut Down Mets 6-1**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies dominated the New York Mets, winning 6-1 behind a strong performance from Jesús Luzardo, who earned the win with 5.0 IP, 7 K, 1 ER, 2 BB, 2 H. Trea Turner led the Mets with 3 hits, including a home run.

top_news.title: **Athletics RHP Justin Sterner Placed on 15-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Athletics right-handed pitcher Justin Sterner has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right knee chondromalacia. The injury occurred on July 18, 2026.

top_news.title: **Cubs Acquire Aaron Civale in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs have acquired right-handed pitcher Aaron Civale in a trade with the Athletics. Civale joins the Cubs after being dealt for right-handed pitcher Aiden Moffett.
